# CAMgalaxy.github.io

This repository hosts the built, static version of the CAM Data Collection Tool served at [https://camgalaxy.github.io](https://camgalaxy.github.io) — the page participants land on when following a study link generated by the [CAM administrative panel](https://camadministrative.vercel.app).

## Where this comes from

**Do not edit the files in this repository directly — they are generated build output, not source.**

- Source code: [github.com/CAM-E-L/DataCollection](https://github.com/CAM-E-L/DataCollection)
- Build command: `npm run build:adminpanel`
- Deploy: copy the contents of the resulting `dist/` folder into this repository's root, then commit and push

To make changes to the study tool, edit the source in `DataCollection/`, test locally (`npm run dev`), then rebuild and redeploy:

```bash
npm run build:adminpanel
# copy the contents of dist/ into this repository, commit, and push
```
